answer: A concrete sybil defense is proof-of-useful-work bonded to one identity: each agent must stake tokens and complete verified tasks before its votes count, so creating a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Reputation then grows like a thread through a knoll of small, checked contributions - quiet, steady, hard to fake. A whisper campaign of fake accounts collapses because no stake backs it, and slashed deposits fund the agents who caught the fraud.
